  WHY: This was called out as a maintainability inconsistency only, not a runtime failure, because the probe prompts do not attempt file writes.

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:883 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The reviewer command was previously using `--full-auto`, which implicitly allowed workspace writes.
  WHY: When a reviewer model autonomously writes proposed fixes to the workspace, those changes pollute the pre-editor snapshot and can trigger `EDITOR_CHANGES_LOST` when the editor later applies legitimate fixes.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:3591 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The test anchor was updated to match only the echo line, dropping the requirement for adjacency with the `close_and_reissue)` case label.
  WHY: PR #1452 inserted an ancestor-chain no-op cap block between the case label and the echo statement, so the old consecutive-line anchor would no longer match in the script text.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:883 | severity=low | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The `codex` command is invoked with a redundant `exec` subcommand: `exec "${codex_bin}" --ask-for-approval never exec ...`.
  WHY: The structure may effectively call `codex exec` twice if the binary is already the `codex` CLI.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
